title: Browse fleet list and open a car detail from the listing
description: Verifies a visitor can load the fleet list and open a specific car detail page from the listing successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Scroll through the car list
Click a vehicle card to open its detail page
Verify the selected vehicle detail page is displayed

title: Open WhatsApp CTA from the homepage with page context
description: Verifies the persistent WhatsApp CTA is available on the homepage and opens a WhatsApp deep link with prefilled homepage context.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]
Click the persistent WhatsApp call-to-action
Verify the browser opens a WhatsApp deep link with a prefilled message that includes homepage context

title: Use WhatsApp CTA from offers page with offer context
description: Verifies the persistent WhatsApp CTA on the offers page opens a WhatsApp deep link with prefilled context about the offer/page.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/offers
Wait for the offers list to finish loading
Click an offer from the list to open its details
Click the persistent WhatsApp call-to-action
Verify a WhatsApp deep link is opened with prefilled message context for the current offer/page

title: Switch locale and use WhatsApp CTA from Arabic offers
description: Verifies switching to Arabic allows browsing offers and the WhatsApp CTA opens with Arabic offer/page context.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/offers
Click the locale switch control to change to Arabic
Wait for the Arabic offers page to finish loading
Click an offer from the list to open its details
Click the persistent WhatsApp call-to-action
Verify a WhatsApp deep link is opened with prefilled message context for the current Arabic offer/page

title: Submit a booking request from a selected car
description: Verifies a lead can select a vehicle, complete the booking request form, submit it, and see an on-site confirmation with a WhatsApp continuation option.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Click a vehicle card to open its detail page
Initiate a booking request from the vehicle detail page
Fill a valid pickup date into the pickup date field
Fill a valid dropoff date into the dropoff date field
Select a pickup location
Select a dropoff location
Fill "Test Lead" into the name field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill "lead.test@example.com" into the email field
Submit the booking request
Verify a booking request confirmation is displayed
Verify a WhatsApp continuation option is available from the confirmation

title: Filter fleet by class to narrow results
description: Verifies a visitor can apply a class filter and see the fleet results update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Select a vehicle class in the filters
Verify the fleet results are narrowed to match the selected class

title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully
description: Verifies a visitor can submit the contact form with required details and sees an in-page confirmation along with a WhatsApp follow-up CTA.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Fill a full name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Fill an inquiry message into the message field
Submit the inquiry form
Verify an in-page submission confirmation is visible
Verify a WhatsApp follow-up call-to-action is visible

title: Filter fleet by price band to narrow results
description: Verifies a visitor can apply a price band filter and see the fleet results update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Select a price band in the filters
Verify the fleet results are narrowed to match the selected price band

title: Use WhatsApp follow-up after a successful inquiry
description: Verifies that after submitting an inquiry, the WhatsApp CTA opens a WhatsApp deep link that includes prefilled context from the contact page.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Fill a full name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Fill an inquiry message into the message field
Submit the inquiry form
Click the WhatsApp follow-up call-to-action
Verify the browser opens a WhatsApp deep link with a prefilled message that includes contact page context

title: WhatsApp CTA remains accessible after scrolling a long page
description: Verifies the persistent WhatsApp CTA remains usable after the user scrolls and still opens a WhatsApp deep link with page context.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/faq
Scroll to the bottom of the page
Click the persistent WhatsApp call-to-action
Verify the browser opens a WhatsApp deep link with a prefilled message that includes FAQ page context

title: Booking request retains selected car context through submission
description: Verifies that when a booking request is started from a specific vehicle detail page, the confirmation reflects that the request is associated with the selected vehicle.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Click a vehicle card to open its detail page
Initiate a booking request from the vehicle detail page
Fill a valid pickup date into the pickup date field
Fill a valid dropoff date into the dropoff date field
Select a pickup location
Select a dropoff location
Fill "Context Check" into the name field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Submit the booking request
Verify a booking request confirmation is displayed
Verify the confirmation indicates the request is for the selected vehicle

title: Browse offers list and open an offer detail
description: Verifies a visitor can view available offers and open a specific offer to see its details.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/offers
Wait for the offers list to finish loading
Click an offer from the list to open its details
Verify the offer detail view is displayed

title: Combine class and price filters together
description: Verifies a visitor can apply both class and price filters and the fleet list reflects both constraints.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Select a vehicle class in the filters
Select a price band in the filters
Verify the fleet results reflect both the selected class and selected price band

title: Login and view dashboard booking requests
description: Verifies a returning user can sign in and reach the dashboard where their booking requests and statuses are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard and a list of booking requests with statuses is displayed

title: Recover from validation errors and submit successfully
description: Verifies a visitor can correct missing required fields after validation errors and then submit successfully with a confirmation shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Submit the inquiry form
Fill a full name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Fill an inquiry message into the message field
Submit the inquiry form
Verify an in-page submission confirmation is visible

title: Correct booking validation errors and submit successfully
description: Verifies a lead can fix missing required fields after validation errors and successfully submit a booking request to get a confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Click a vehicle card to open its detail page
Initiate a booking request from the vehicle detail page
Submit the booking request without filling required fields
Fill a valid pickup date into the pickup date field
Fill a valid dropoff date into the dropoff date field
Select a pickup location
Select a dropoff location
Fill "Fix Errors" into the name field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Submit the booking request
Verify a booking request confirmation is displayed

title: Offers can be referenced via inquiry entry point
description: Verifies a visitor can start an inquiry journey from an offer context without losing the offer reference intent.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/offers
Wait for the offers list to finish loading
Click an offer from the list to open its details
Click the call-to-action to inquire about the offer
Verify the user is presented with an inquiry entry point that reflects the current offer context

title: Submit a contact inquiry with optional fields included
description: Verifies the contact form accepts optional details and still completes submission with a visible confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Fill a full name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Select a residency type
Fill a valid date into the preferred date field
Fill a budget amount into the budget field
Fill an inquiry message into the message field
Submit the inquiry form
Verify an in-page submission confirmation is visible

title: Protected dashboard redirects unauthenticated user to login and returns after login
description: Verifies an unauthenticated visitor who opens the dashboard is redirected to login and, after signing in, is taken to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/dashboard
Wait for the login page to load
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Session persists on page refresh in dashboard
description: Verifies the authenticated session remains active and the dashboard content still loads after a browser refresh.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Press F5
Verify the dashboard is still accessible and booking requests are displayed

title: Locale switch shows correct language content on FAQ/About
description: Verifies switching locale updates the content language correctly for FAQ and About pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/faq
Click the locale switch control to change to Arabic
Wait for the Arabic FAQ page to finish loading
Click the link to view the About page
Verify the About page content is displayed in Arabic

title: Booking form blocks submission when required fields are missing
description: Verifies a lead cannot submit an incomplete booking request and sees inline validation prompting required fields.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet
Wait for the fleet list to finish loading
Click a vehicle card to open its detail page
Initiate a booking request from the vehicle detail page
Submit the booking request without filling required fields
Verify inline validation errors are displayed for missing required fields

title: Prevent inquiry submission when required fields are missing
description: Verifies submitting the contact form without required details shows inline validation and does not submit.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Submit the inquiry form
Verify inline validation errors are visible for required fields
Verify no submission confirmation is shown

title: Read FAQ content
description: Verifies a visitor can open the FAQ page and view the FAQ entries.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/faq
Wait for the FAQ page to finish loading
Verify FAQ entries are displayed

title: Invalid credentials show login error and do not enter dashboard
description: Verifies entering invalid credentials prevents access and shows an on-page error state.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/login
Fill invalid.user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrongpassword into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify a login error is visible and the user is not shown the dashboard

title: Reject invalid email format on the inquiry form
description: Verifies entering an invalid email prevents submission and shows an inline email validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /[locale]/contact
Fill a full name into the name field
Fill an invalid email format into the email field
Fill an inquiry message into the message field
Submit the inquiry form
Verify an inline email validation error is visible
Verify no submission confirmation is shown

title: Offers page supports empty state without breaking navigation
description: Verifies the offers page remains usable and presents an appropriate empty state when no offers are shown in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/offers
Wait for the offers page to finish loading
Verify either offers are displayed or an empty state message is visible

title: Read About page content
description: Verifies a visitor can open the About page and view company information content.

steps.description: Navigate to /en/about
Wait for the About page to finish loading
Verify company information content is displayed
